question: In the year 1925, who extracted lipids from an erythrocyte sample and found that lipid monolayers are good for measuring molecular surface area versus lateral pressure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gorter and Grendel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In 1925, Dutch scientists **Evert Gorter and François Grendel** conducted a groundbreaking experiment involving erythrocyte (red blood cell) lipid extraction.
 
• They found that the lipids extracted from erythrocytes could form a monolayer, which was pivotal in understanding the molecular surface area versus lateral pressure.
 
• Their work was fundamental in the development of the **fluid mosaic model of cell membranes**.
 
• Gorter and Grendel's experiment was one of the first to suggest that cell membranes are composed of a lipid bilayer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lipid Monolayers and Bilayers:**

 
 
• A **lipid monolayer** is a single layer of lipid molecules arranged on the surface of the water, with their hydrophobic tails in the air and hydrophilic heads in the water.
 
• A **lipid bilayer** is a double layer of lipids that form the fundamental structure of cell membranes, with hydrophobic tails facing inward and hydrophilic heads facing outward.
 
• These structures are crucial for maintaining the integrity and functionality of cell membranes.
 
 
 
• **Erythrocytes (Red Blood Cells):**
 
 
• Erythrocytes are the most common type of blood cell and are responsible for transporting oxygen from the lungs to the body's tissues and carbon dioxide from the tissues back to the lungs.
 
• Their membrane composition and properties are essential for their deformability and functionality.
 
 
 
• **Surface Area vs. Lateral Pressure:**
 
 
• This concept involves measuring the surface area occupied by lipid molecules as a function of the lateral pressure applied to the monolayer.
 
• It is used to study the physical properties of lipid layers and understand cell membrane mechanics.
 
 
 
• **Fluid Mosaic Model:**
 
 
• Proposed by Singer and Nicolson in 1972, this model describes the cell membrane as a fluid combination of lipids and proteins.
 
• The lipids provide a flexible matrix, while proteins float in or on this lipid bilayer, contributing to various cellular functions.
